reason: In spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb:114-117, the 'cannot remove members from automatic groups' spec calls `xhr :put, :remove_member, group_id: 1, user_id: 42` on line 115, whereas config/routes.rb:49 routes `DELETE members` to `groups#remove_member` (and line 50 maps `PUT members` to `groups#add_members`). Because Rails controller specs dispatch directly to the named controller action without enforcing the HTTP verb against the router, the test passes despite using `:put` instead of `:delete`.
